metadata.heading_title: Of Mortgages of Immoveable Property and Charges

heading.title: Of Mortgages of Immoveable Property and Charges

article.title: Postponement of prior mortgagee.
article.content:
78Postponement of prior mortgagee.

Section 78  ·  Chapter IV  ·  Priority  ·  page 33 of the Act
Where, through the fraud, misrepresentation or gross neglect of a prior mortgagee, another person has been induced to advance money on the security of the mortgaged property, the prior mortgagee shall be postponed to the subsequent mortgagee.
